state:Andhra Pradesh.text: The Andhra Pradesh government has heavily prioritized artificial intelligence infrastructure, securing massive investments from major technology firms like Google and Reliance to establish hyperscale AI data centers and hubs in Visakhapatnam and Amaravati [R42588509, R1349768b, R281487d7]. To support this rapid technological expansion, the state has approved specialized AI policies, initiated plans for dedicated AI and quantum universities in partnership with entities like NVIDIA and NIELIT, and rolled out extensive youth skilling programs [R78ad8544, R2d894836, R9fe15d9b]. Furthermore, the administration has integrated AI applications across various public sectors, including urban flood forecasting, GST tax administration, healthcare delivery, and police monitoring [Ra460605d, R6e71a6d9, R1e515ffc, R84d949ed].

state:Bihar.text: The Government of Bihar has aggressively pursued artificial intelligence adoption across governance, education, and public infrastructure through strategic partnerships with major tech firms like Google, Microsoft, and Singapore-based GFTN [R6fdc0aaa, R57e2c2ec, Rd71e810d]. The state cabinet approved the establishment of the ₹190.32 crore Bihar AI Mission aimed at training thousands of youth, supporting startups, and modernizing technical education [R68b64920]. Concurrently, the state has integrated AI into school and higher education, deploying teacher training programs, digital learning spaces, and specialized curricula [Reb7bfdb3, R3beb3201, Re18a3100]. Furthermore, AI applications are being rolled out to optimize public services, including healthcare management, traffic control, land-revenue tracking, and administrative e-Cabinet systems [Re986d143, R79e87d3a, Ra3ee576b, Rf5a14e8f].

state:Gujarat.text: The Government of Gujarat has actively advanced artificial intelligence through infrastructure development, targeted governance applications, and educational initiatives. Key infrastructure efforts include the establishment of AI and data center clusters near GIFT City [Rb322fa47, R42b5efe9], a statewide GPU-as-a-Service framework [Rd1b68bba], and the Data Centre Policy 2026-29 aiming for Green AI capacity and mandatory renewable power integration [Re041bd74, R0d737a25, R43f4ae2b]. State governance is leveraging AI across sectors such as agricultural paddy quality testing [Re71562c3], dairy farming guidance via the Amul AI platform [Ra310e3fc], police surveillance challenges [R28ccc09b], and student dropout prevention [R88fee491]. Additionally, the state has initiated a major student training mission targeting 5 lakh students and thousands of faculty members [Ra6932da2], while the Gujarat High Court has concurrently enacted policies prohibiting AI use in judicial decision-making and judgment drafting [Rbd9766bd].

state:Karnataka.text: Karnataka has pursued widespread artificial intelligence initiatives spanning education, governance, infrastructure, and industry partnerships. Significant actions include introducing AI curricula and training programs in government schools and colleges [R8176ca19, Rb1015546, R85c64f43], planning an AI university alongside centers of excellence [Rc16dddf8, Re78dfed2], and deploying AI tools for public administration, agriculture, and citizen service delivery [Ra61ec765, Rf518fff6, R9d27904f]. The state has also advanced major physical infrastructure plans, such as the Bidadi AI Township and specialized AI hubs, while collaborating with international firms and research bodies [R2c8e9508, R567ab120, R4e7f795d].

state:Maharashtra.text: Maharashtra has advanced its artificial intelligence ecosystem through comprehensive policy approvals, significant infrastructure investments, and targeted governance frameworks [R562864e1, R03b6b6d6]. The state cabinet approved an AI policy backed by a ₹10,000 crore investment plan and established dedicated oversight committees and a new IT-AI department [R562864e1, Rd7d40f74, R5afedf9c]. Key initiatives span multiple sectors, including the deployment of 'Maha AI' for governance, Sarvam AI tools for government operations, and partnerships with technology firms for green data centres and AI innovation hubs [R68fee1a0, Re0b416d1, R03b6b6d6]. Additionally, the state has integrated AI into public services, policing, education, and agriculture through specialized platforms and pilot projects [R04592b70, R44b25a30, Rcd594eaf].

state:Odisha.text: Odisha has advanced its artificial intelligence ecosystem through major industrial investments and infrastructure projects, including partnerships with Sarvam AI to establish sovereign AI and compute facilities, alongside multi-billion-rupee data centre proposals from firms like HCLTech and the Adani Group [R31b27cb7, R78b0f274, R230b6e3b, R3a36bb44]. The state government has integrated AI into public administration and citizen service delivery through platforms like the 'Ama Sathi' WhatsApp chatbot, AI-enabled governance systems, and automated traffic and surveillance deployments [Rd731fc75, Rabdf8555, R8a2dd09f, R2439bfe6]. Furthermore, Odisha has actively promoted AI education, digital skills training, and workforce development by embedding AI into school and university curricula and establishing dedicated robotics and STEM labs [Rdb5da3c5, Rf1f957f6, R7b1537aa, R7b9bb8d3].

state:Punjab.text: Punjab has pursued widespread integration of artificial intelligence across education, governance, agriculture, and law enforcement. The state education system introduced AI as a core and mainstream curriculum subject in government schools for classes ranging from Class I to XII [Rf6319e99, Re45fa955, R5c2eec42]. Concurrently, law enforcement agencies deployed AI-powered tools, voice recognition systems, and smart command centers in partnership with IIT Ropar to track criminals and dismantle organized crime [R7333c0ad, R132d8a77, Re289fcd5]. State initiatives also leveraged AI for agricultural advisory services, healthcare screening, and infrastructure monitoring [R609b6fc5, Ree614b14, R4e4970c3].

state:Tamil Nadu.text: Tamil Nadu has aggressively advanced its artificial intelligence ecosystem through major infrastructure developments, including partnerships for a Sovereign AI Park and an AI-ready data center campus [R472c3c1a, R70cb396d]. The state government has integrated AI into public service delivery and governance by launching WhatsApp chatbots like 'Namma Arasu' and 'NalamAI' for healthcare and administrative functions [R576baa19, Re58fb67d]. Furthermore, educational initiatives such as the TN SPARK program and teacher training via SCERT are actively introducing AI tools into government schools [R9cd35018, Rfe24cede]. Conservation efforts have also benefited significantly, with AI-based early warning systems successfully preventing elephant fatalities along railway tracks [Rc2b44680, R31409be3].

state:Telangana.text: Telangana has actively pursued artificial intelligence integration across infrastructure, governance, and skill development, highlighted by large investments in data center campuses and the establishment of the Telangana AI Innovation Hub [Rd6f74125, Rb99e617b, Ra0d04f11]. The state government has launched various AI-driven initiatives in public services, including policing enhancements, agricultural market solutions, and weather alert systems for farmers [Ra1409382, R45e372bd, R020669b4]. Additionally, partnerships with tech majors and academic institutions have driven extensive AI literacy and green skills training programs targeted at students and youth across the state [R998e03d5, R3bfd0d73, R89c590e8].

state:Uttar Pradesh.text: Uttar Pradesh has advanced artificial intelligence initiatives through major infrastructure investments, including plans to build an AI city in Lucknow and approve a robotics and AI park in Greater Noida [R3cf60d9f, Rb1cbd4df]. The state government has also signed high-value memorandums of understanding for data centers and compute hubs to expand its digital framework [R212c0bcb, R6af01bf4]. Furthermore, authorities are integrating AI into public administration, law enforcement, education, and healthcare through various skilling programs and governance projects [Rb312992b, Ra6233201, Re48eb24d, R1e320eca].

category:strategy_policy.text: State governments across India are actively shaping AI policy through dedicated missions, infrastructure hubs, and legislative frameworks [R562864e1, R6fdc0aaa]. Major initiatives include Maharashtra approving an AI policy with a ₹10,000 crore investment [R562864e1], and Chhattisgarh rolling out a ₹500 crore AI Mission focused on skill development and governance [R7cc53f61]. States are also prioritizing targeted talent development, such as Bihar's AI training programs for students and Uttar Pradesh's establishment of startup-focused AI hubs [R4af400f2, Rb312992b]. Furthermore, several regions are investing heavily in physical infrastructure, launching specialized IT-AI cities, data centre policies, and green AI facilities [R1b6cbab3, Re041bd74, R3eefbde9].

category:regulation_ethics.text: State governments and judicial bodies have actively pursued regulatory and ethical frameworks regarding artificial intelligence, focusing heavily on the judiciary, data privacy, and governance standards [Rbd9766bd, R9b3c768e, R607d069a]. Several high courts, including those in Gujarat, Kerala, and Punjab and Haryana, have prohibited or restricted the use of AI tools in decision-making, judgment drafting, and legal research to preserve public trust and prevent reliance on non-existent case laws [Rbd9766bd, R12b7585e, R3cc78d30, R8eacd504]. Additionally, states like Karnataka, Maharashtra, and Telangana have introduced or proposed specialized committees, standard operating procedures, and departmental guidelines to ensure the ethical use of AI, protect confidential data, and mandate labelling for synthetic content [R9b3c768e, Rba8badb1, R607d069a, Ra75d01a2, R7c216cfc].

category:funding_budget.text: State governments across India have actively allocated funding and approved extensive budgets for artificial intelligence initiatives, data infrastructure, and specialized missions [R7cc53f61, Rb312992b, R297b1b1d]. Major financial commitments include Chhattisgarh's Rs 500 crore AI Mission and Uttar Pradesh's implementation of programs worth Rs 2,000 crore under its AI mission [R7cc53f61, R77645065]. States are also driving large-scale infrastructure and industrial projects, such as Maharashtra approving Rs 11.26 crore to roll out Sarvam AI alongside multi-crore data center investments in Odisha and Andhra Pradesh [R68fee1a0, R657bba09, R3eefbde9]. Additionally, regional funding targets sector-specific applications, including dedicated agricultural AI policies, startup funds, and educational skill development missions [Re3333cd0, Rda0dbcb5, R0c270c1c].

category:infrastructure.text: State governments across India are heavily investing in AI infrastructure, launching massive data center parks, sovereign compute projects, and specialized cities. Notable projects include multi-gigawatt data center hubs and AI cities proposed or approved in states like Andhra Pradesh, Uttar Pradesh, Telangana, Maharashtra, and Odisha [R42588509, R398131aa, Rf8ceda95, R00b3c6a6]. Additionally, states are establishing artificial intelligence universities, specialized robotics and AI parks, and Centers of Excellence to drive regional tech ecosystems and research [R2d894836, Rb1cbd4df, R6ae1aafc, Re78dfed2]. Governments are also rolling out localized infrastructure such as state-wide GPU frameworks, AI labs in educational institutions, and digital skilling programs to support the broader ecosystem [Rd1b68bba, Rb1015546, R0e4ecbd7].

category:partnership.text: State governments across India have actively pursued partnerships and Memorandums of Understanding (MoUs) to advance local artificial intelligence infrastructure, data centers, and digital economies [R44971ae6, R42588509, Reff5d158]. Major technology investments and hyperscale AI data center projects have been secured through collaborations with global firms like Google, Microsoft, IBM, and various infrastructure developers in states such as Andhra Pradesh, Bihar, Gujarat, Maharashtra, and Telangana [R5b4a7a80, R42588509, Re43fd68f, Re0b416d1]. Additionally, states are forming educational and governance partnerships with technology companies and institutions to train teachers, upskill youth, and integrate AI into public services, healthcare, and agriculture [Reb7bfdb3, R65d60606, R6de84b70].

category:deployment.text: State governments have heavily deployed artificial intelligence across citizen services, public safety, health, and administrative workflows. Notable applications include WhatsApp and voice-based chatbots for public services and healthcare in states like Odisha, Tamil Nadu, and Karnataka [Rabdf8555, R576baa19, Rff273deb], alongside AI tools for policing, law enforcement, and exam surveillance in Maharashtra, Uttar Pradesh, and Punjab [R04592b70, Re0c4ff32, R7333c0ad]. States are also integrating AI into agriculture, welfare fraud detection, education, and infrastructure—such as traffic and flood management systems—to streamline governance [R27258895, Rd78856c5, Ra460605d].

category:skilling.text: State governments have actively pursued AI skilling initiatives by integrating artificial intelligence into school curricula, establishing specialized training programs, and collaborating with technology firms and industry partners [Rf6319e99, R8176ca19, R5956406b]. Several states have introduced AI subjects or early tech training in government schools, while also partnering with companies like Google and Microsoft to build AI labs and upskill educators [Rf6319e99, R8176ca19, Reb7bfdb3, R06697b72]. Additionally, states have launched broad youth training missions, vocational courses, and professional development programs to expand technical capabilities across different demographics [Ra6932da2, Rb312992b, R1e320eca].

category:events_outreach.text: Indian state governments have actively engaged in events, summits, and hackathons focused on artificial intelligence, technology, and digital governance to attract investments and foster skill development [R84a7e58c, R0a523d7f, R1dd96b45]. Numerous states, including Uttar Pradesh, Karnataka, Gujarat, and Uttarakhand, have hosted high-profile technology conferences, regional AI impact summits, and specialized workshops addressing sectors like health, agriculture, and education [Rc7e57d12, Rec3b838b, R2d4fffde, Reb9a8d36]. Additionally, several administrations have organized hackathons and boot camps in collaboration with industry partners to promote real-world AI innovation and enhance administrative efficiency [Rc7e57d12, Rb8c534c6, R28ccc09b, R24998453]. State delegations have also participated in international forums and global tech events to showcase their local AI ecosystems and establish strategic partnerships [R2ae053d2].

state:Kerala.text: Kerala has integrated artificial intelligence across multiple sectors, deploying AI cameras for traffic monitoring and public safety alongside judicial tools like mandatory transcription systems [R6d538903, Rf2c35456]. The state government has also focused heavily on education and administration by launching teacher training programs, student robotics initiatives, and administrative governance overhauls [Rc3656b09, R3db21292, R8f4114ad]. Furthermore, Kerala is actively positioning itself as an emerging technology hub through the establishment of twin AI Centres of Excellence, startup funds, and substantial data centre investments [Raa18758, Re3333cd0, Ra525c46d].

category:governance_body.text: Several Indian states have established dedicated governance bodies, ministries, and specialized task forces to institutionalize artificial intelligence in public administration. Kerala and Tamil Nadu introduced dedicated AI portfolios and ministries [R6bbe2d82, Ref475c84], while states like Maharashtra, Gujarat, Haryana, and Karnataka formed high-level committees, policy task forces, and specialized AI cells to oversee ethical frameworks, police modernization, and administrative reforms [R9b3c768e, R5afedf9c, Ra6b5d331, Re88286cf]. Additionally, departments focusing on information technology and future technologies have been rebranded or newly created in states like Kerala and Maharashtra to drive comprehensive digital transformation and AI integration across sectors [Ref58a154, R6f0677ec].

overall.text: Indian state governments have widely pursued artificial intelligence initiatives focusing on infrastructure investments, educational integration, and governance enhancements [R31b27cb7, Rf6319e99, Rd731fc75]. Several states approved formal policies and established dedicated facilities, such as data centre campuses, sovereign AI parks, and specialized innovation hubs [R6a6bee70, R1b6cbab3, R472c3c1a]. Concurrently, states have integrated AI into public education and professional training through school curricula, boot camps, and dedicated learning portals [Rf6319e99, R27258895, Rc119f335]. Furthermore, administrative applications include police modernization, cybercrime tools, multilingual platforms, and AI-driven governance systems [Rd731fc75, R04592b70, Rad868781].

state:Assam.text: Assam has actively pursued an AI-driven transformation across governance, education, healthcare, and infrastructure, mapping hundreds of proposals and commissioning a government-owned GPU cluster to power state services [R936eb0aa, R416e5d33]. Key initiatives include deploying artificial intelligence for flood rescue via WhatsApp, forest encroachment and deforestation monitoring, and wildlife protection through automated train collision alerts and monitoring systems [Rc2490b65, R9c52da90, R037e76ac, Rddd6a227, R692a244d]. The state has also integrated AI tools into schools and teacher training programs in partnership with Google and UNICEF, alongside introducing AI anchors and administrative systems like 'ALISA' [R5a187c0b, R39b50ddb, Re167bad2, R68e89c81].

state:Chhattisgarh.text: Chhattisgarh is actively advancing its digital infrastructure and governance through a Rs 500 crore AI Mission, focusing on skill development, data centers, and establishing multiple Centers of Excellence [R7cc53f61, R6ae1aafc, R63bfb6f9]. The state has launched several education and training initiatives, such as partnering with Google to train two lakh teachers and introducing AI and coding modules for students in tribal and rural areas [R398fad0d, R1445ea1e, Rf7c7fd70]. Furthermore, artificial intelligence applications are being deployed across public safety, wildlife conservation, and law enforcement for tasks like elephant tracking, road monitoring, and fraud detection [R96ea213d, Reb028d74, R1dec6260, R6c86e7f3].

state:Haryana.text: Haryana has actively advanced its artificial intelligence initiatives across governance, policing, and education under the Haryana AI Mission [Ra92a52de, R27de87ff]. The state approved a Rs 474.39 crore project with World Bank support to fund the Haryana AI Development Project and establish an AI center [R56704031, Ra22a77b9]. Key implementations include AI-driven policing and cybercrime tracking [R8606b20d], language-first legislative tools [R7939cefb], and specialized chatbots for public services like land management [R4f453e9d]. Furthermore, the state has integrated emerging tech and AI training into schools, vocational institutes, and agriculture sectors [Rea550810, Rcd5e27a7, Rb4ae5aa0].

state:Himachal Pradesh.text: Himachal Pradesh has actively integrated artificial intelligence across education, governance, healthcare, and environmental management [Re82f2564]. In the education sector, initiatives range from launching digital platforms like the 'Padhai with AI' app and the Vidhya Samiksha Kendra to introducing AI, data science, and drone technology courses in schools and higher education [Rb23a865a, R39cd627c, Rbc10366f, Rc9d96f12]. Governance and public services are being transformed through AI-based document verification on portals, fraud detection in health schemes, and advanced disaster risk and forest intelligence systems [R38e56e62, Rc3a3d3b4, R26835c79, Rc1ad1a5c]. Additionally, the state has advanced healthcare with robotic-assisted surgery facilities and partnered with institutions like IIT Mandi for forensic and safety mapping tools [R19aa9a66, Reb98bbcd, Rc06b19cc].

state:Jharkhand.text: The government of Jharkhand has advanced artificial intelligence initiatives across multiple sectors, anchored by the draft Jharkhand AI Policy 2026 and the Vision 2050 roadmap aimed at driving investments, governance, and job creation [R7694c76a, R927ec078]. Major developments include infrastructure projects like a data centre and AI tools for the High Court, mandatory AI use for quality control in infrastructure, and specialized AI monitoring tools for public safety, healthcare tracking, and wildlife management [Re675872a, Rde702427, Rb7cd9ee5, Rd53d5e43]. Additionally, the state is expanding educational and training programs through new AI labs, school smart classes, and centers of excellence to build a skilled workforce [R8022329a, R95bbe8d6, R86310780].

state:Madhya Pradesh.text: Madhya Pradesh has increasingly integrated artificial intelligence across governance, public services, law enforcement, and economic development initiatives [R6473839f]. The state government partnered with Google Cloud to drive AI-powered governance and utilized AI analytics to detect financial anomalies and irregularities in urban civic purchases and procurement [R9069faa1, R6473839f, R4c96f220]. In law enforcement and public safety, authorities deployed AI surveillance systems like 'Trinetra' for crowd and temple management, established AI monitoring towers to curb illegal sand mining, and incorporated AI tools into police training and operations [R085470af, R80dec475, Ra365ac4c]. Additionally, the state has promoted technological infrastructure and education through initiatives such as planning AI data centers, advancing semiconductor and chip packaging investments, and launching AI training programs for educators and students [Rd5bd5d63, R4df0843d, R5d3f24d3].

state:Manipur.text: Manipur has integrated artificial intelligence across governance, education, legal proceedings, and conservation efforts since late 2022. Significant actions include the Manipur High Court using ChatGPT for legal research and delivering a landmark verdict [Rc647f8ab, R647a600d, Rdb89b488], and partnerships with Microsoft and the BHASHINI Division to advance multilingual AI and digital governance [Rad868781, Rdc31ca32]. The state has also promoted AI in classrooms and academic research, launched an AI career guidance hub, and explored AI applications for wildlife trafficking and tribal development [Rbb7d36a7, R7249ca9d, Re9f95033, R13590541]. Additionally, initiatives span digital tourism, journalism workshops, and language translation tools like the app 'Ishaan' [R49d826c3, R3413274d, R0ffcf77b].

state:Meghalaya.text: Meghalaya is actively integrating artificial intelligence across multiple sectors, including governance, public health, agriculture, and environmental management [Rac5495f0, Rf1f88f85, R84a1eeb7]. The state has hosted regional AI conferences, drafted a new IT policy focused on AI and global capability centres, and proposed a Rs 20 crore AI Centre of Excellence [Rd7994ab1, R9625f972, Rf277c3a3]. Educational initiatives feature AI-powered learning pilots in schools, partnerships for skill development, and the integration of robotics and AI into the curriculum [R24be49c9, Rc935224b, R5aa6ef3e]. Furthermore, technological interventions include AI-driven waste management for Umiam Lake, landslide susceptibility mapping, and data-driven governance systems [Rac5495f0, Rfbdf90e5, R84a1eeb7].

state:Tripura.text: Tripura has positioned itself as an active participant in artificial intelligence adoption, initiating a state-level AI policy and partnering with Google India and IIT Kharagpur to build a regional technology ecosystem [Rc68da9b5, R33168f25, R9435f1d2]. The state government has integrated AI across multiple sectors, including deploying AI tools for tax enforcement, agricultural missions, police traffic management, and healthcare infrastructure [Ra65da593, R2235629e, R8edb04a8, R2748f23d]. Additionally, Tripura has focused heavily on education and digital inclusion by launching AI skill initiatives, free courses for students, and translation services via the BHASHINI initiative [R3fff65a8, R12023632, R2f53bb22].

state:Uttarakhand.text: Uttarakhand has actively advanced its artificial intelligence policies and initiatives across governance, education, and wildlife conservation. Significant actions include mandating AI education across state universities, deploying AI-powered monitoring for forests and wildlife protection, and launching summits like the Devbhoomi AI Summit to position the state as a tech hub [Rcea6d545, Rfadf7808, R8a719696]. Additionally, the state has integrated AI into public services, revenue enforcement, and cyber crime helpline management [Recb1f69d, R549f779d, R35780311].

state:West Bengal.text: West Bengal is actively advancing artificial intelligence integration across industrial, administrative, and educational sectors, anchored by a draft industrial policy and the West Bengal AI Mission focusing on infrastructure, data centres, and MSMEs [Rf93d2652, R0c1ea7de, R90ad9af5]. Governance and public safety initiatives include the formation of a dedicated West Bengal Police AI Cell, an MoU with Rashtriya Raksha University for AI surveillance training, and the deployment of AI-powered applications for investigations, missing persons, and civic service management [Re268e526, R5118fef0, R08e415eb, Rebcdd9ec, R1e4db06d]. Educational reforms feature the introduction of AI, data science, and coding curricula across schools and higher secondary boards, alongside training partnerships with Oracle to upskill thousands of students [Rf61a82a3, Rde3629a0, Rac4428c1, R6da26467, R0c4d9eef].

state:Rajasthan.text: The state of Rajasthan has actively integrated artificial intelligence across governance, public services, and infrastructure by approving targeted policies like the AI-ML Policy 2026 and introducing foundational courses [R6a6bee70, R2c694631]. Significant actions include adopting AI-driven technologies for agricultural development through partnerships with Wadhwani AI, enhancing public security and traffic enforcement with facial recognition and smart cameras, and deploying AI tools in healthcare and power distribution [R6de84b70, Rd7e6b721, Rc6030208, Re141ed2f]. Additionally, the state has leveraged platforms like Rajasthan Sampark to streamline public grievance redressal using AI and video calls [Rcaf01e51, R9f492701].

state:Nagaland.text: Nagaland has actively advanced artificial intelligence initiatives across governance, infrastructure, and education through various workshops, centers, and digital tools. Key developments include the inauguration of an AI Centre of Excellence for Skilling, the unveiling of the Eliona AI Supercomputer for disaster preparedness, and the launch of an AI-powered digital agriculture ecosystem [R6f55ee54, Ra8c17a13, R3a286812]. The state has also integrated AI into public administration and law enforcement via AI-powered number plate reading cameras and capacity-building workshops [R17676278, R7b191484]. Furthermore, educational reforms feature plans to introduce an AI curriculum starting from Class 6, alongside targeted student and faculty development programs [R6e0fb0d1, R8b9ea930, Ree819f7b].

state:Sikkim.text: Sikkim has actively integrated artificial intelligence across multiple sectors, most notably deploying an AI-driven Traffic Management System and e-challan mechanisms to enhance road safety and manage traffic congestion [Re7e20a6f, R24fc93a2, Ref56657c]. In education and agriculture, the state has launched AI-powered learning programs in government schools, partnered with NIELIT Gangtok to establish an AI Centre of Excellence, and pilot-tested an AI-enabled WhatsApp chatbot to support farmers [R27258895, Red4520ff, R2569fc2d]. Additionally, the government has advanced technology adoption by introducing an AI-based permit system to boost tourism and discussing AI applications for disaster prediction and higher education partnerships [Rfc6c0173, Rb685bb8f, R604d927c].
